scripts.studio: bun run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: bun run audio && remotion render src/index.ts TradeVault out/tradevault-20s.mp4
scripts.render:web: remotion render src/index.ts TradeVault out/tradevault-20s.webm --codec vp9 --crf 34 --muted
scripts.render:vertical: bun run audio && for v in FR-A FR-B EN-A EN-B; do remotion render src/index.ts Vertical-$v out/tradevault-9x16-$(echo $v | tr A-Z a-z).mp4 --crf 16; done
